response.justification: Broad, deep engineering background with 15+ years across web, embedded, mobile and backend, including genuine high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby (microservices handling millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, fibers, caching) and current hands-on exposure to agentic tooling (MCP code generators, AI-agent infrastructure) at a Staff-level title. However, the resume shows no Python at all — a stated must-have — and the distributed-systems depth is several years in the past and concentrated in DLang rather than the target stack. Evidence of technical strategy, cross-functional stakeholder management, and formal agile/on-call ownership is thin; the profile reads more as a versatile senior full-stack craftsman than a domain-directing Staff IC. Worth a screening call to probe Python proficiency, scale ownership, and strategy scope.
strengths: Real high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience at ad-tech scale
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP/developer-tooling work
Strong TypeScript/Node depth plus craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based)
concerns: No Python evidence despite it being a must-have skill
Little demonstrated technical strategy, stakeholder management, or on-call ownership
Scale/distributed work is dated (2018–2020) and language-specific to DLang

key_factors.factor: AI-agent tooling exposure at Staff level
